title: Recap: LLMs are General Purpose models
reading: A recap slide framing large language models as general-purpose systems along three axes of generality. First, generality of architecture: a single architecture or system supports a wide range of tasks. Second, generality of concepts across skills: the model can perform tasks made of unseen skill-concept combinations. Third, generality of learning: new tasks can be learned efficiently from descriptions and in-context examples rather than retraining.

visuals.description: Three parallel labelled panels or columns, each pairing a short description with a heading: 'Generality of Architecture', 'Generality of Concepts across Skills', 'Generality of Learning'.
visuals.assertion: LLM generality decomposes into three distinct dimensions: architectural breadth, compositional skill-concept transfer, and efficient task learning.

concepts.name: Generality of Architecture
concepts.why_it_matters: One system handles many tasks without task-specific redesign.

concepts.name: Generality of Concepts across Skills
concepts.why_it_matters: Captures compositional generalisation to unseen skill-concept pairings.

concepts.name: Generality of Learning
concepts.why_it_matters: Underlies in-context learning and instruction following.

concepts.name: In-context examples
concepts.why_it_matters: Mechanism by which LLMs adapt without parameter updates.
